Requirements: R-8
Plan row: TS-10

## Given
A guest with an empty cart; an id N that no book has (positive integer).

## Steps
1. POST /api/cart {bookId: N, quantity: 1}.
2. GET /api/cart.

## Then
1. P-unknownid: the answer is the status and code that Q4 gives for an unknown book (not a 500).
2. GET /api/cart, read independently, holds what Q4 gives for it after that call.
